name: Operation Fresh Start Legacy Program
what_you_do: You do paid, hands-on conservation or construction work. You get mentoring while you work toward a diploma. You earn an AmeriCorps Education Award when you finish.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 24 in the Dane County area. Juniors and seniors need a referral from their home school. MMSD applicants must be entering the fourth quarter of junior year before applying.
pay_detail: Bi-weekly stipend (amount not stated). Finishers may earn an AmeriCorps Education Award of about $2,800 for college.
duration: At least 1,000 program hours (total length not stated)
deadline_text: No deadline listed. Open status not confirmed as of Nov 4, 2026. Call (608) 244-4721.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Now button on the Legacy page (opens a Google Form). Seniors and juniors also need a referral from their home school.
notes: The site blocked automated reading of the Legacy page on Nov 4, 2026, so call to confirm how to apply. Free program. Staff mentor graduates for one year after completion. Phone (608) 244-4721, info@operationfreshstart.org, 2670 Milwaukee St, Madison. The program starts at 16, so the Wisconsin permit rule for 14 and 15 year olds does not apply to it.
